package.name: threevn_bringup
package.description:
Launch and controller configuration for the 3VN Arm, independent of execution target.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: this package must NEVER depend on ros_gz, gz_ros2_control, or anything else Gazebo-specific. If it did, deploying to the physical robot would drag the simulator along and the project's central claim - that the application does not care whether it talks to Gazebo or to hardware - would be false at the dependency level. Gazebo lives in threevn_sim, which depends on THIS package and not the other way round.
test_package_dependencies.py enforces this.
